name: 16828-random1k100-24b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), nothing else on the card.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; the 47 GB bf16 checkpoint fits one 80 GB card.
load_profile: constant (open loop), rate = 9 req/s, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1080 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, fixed 1000 prompt tokens / 100 output tokens (min = max = nominal on both), `request_format: plain`, `temperature: 0.0`; the output length is forced by `max_tokens` plus `ignore_eos=True` on every request.
purpose: A 24-billion-parameter assistant drafting short replies from page-long prompts at nine requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Nothing here is tuned. The engine is the commit named in `configs/setupcard.md`, built from
# source; `configs/env.yaml` says where that build lives on this machine.

model: mistralai/Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Written out rather than left to default: the in-process engine path is in no per-context
# default table and would fall through to 2048 batched tokens, a quarter of this scheduler width.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 4096

# The attention backend cannot be written here -- this engine has no `attention_backend`
# argument. It is an environment variable, set in `configs/tuned.yaml`.
